segments.name: Bank
products: commercial and residential real estate loans
segments.description: A full-service community bank offering deposit accounts and a wide range of lending services to customers in Missouri.
segments.evidence: The Bank is a full service bank and, through the Bank segment, conducts a general banking business, offering its customers checking and savings accounts, internet banking, debit cards, certificates of deposit, brokerage services, safety deposit boxes and a wide range of lending services, including commercial and industrial loans, single payment personal loans, installment loans and commercial and residential real estate loans.

segments.name: Wealth Management
segments.description: Provides financial and investment planning services for individuals and business owners, as well as trust services.
segments.evidence: The Bank also offers, through the Wealth Management segment, a broad range of financial and investment planning services for individuals and business owners, as well as trust services formerly included in the Bank segment.

revenueModel.text: The Bank earns revenue from customers through deposit accounts and a wide range of lending services, including commercial, consumer and real estate loans.
revenueModel.evidence: conducts a general banking business, offering its customers checking and savings accounts, internet banking, debit cards, certificates of deposit, brokerage services, safety deposit boxes and a wide range of lending services

changes.text: In 2025, the Company identified Wealth Management as a separate reportable segment, moving from one reportable segment (the Bank) to two.
changes.evidence: As a result, beginning with the first quarter of 2025, the Company identified its Wealth Management Business as a separate reportable segment and now has two reportable segments: the Bank segment and the Wealth Management segment.
